title: CreatorProfile V3
description: A slim cross-task creator profile containing stable, currently usable values. Time-window metrics, rankings, provenance wrappers, and persistence metadata are excluded.

schema_version.description: The profile contract version; it is not the profile revision.

profile_id.description: Stable identifier for the creator profile.

accounts.description: Platform accounts associated with this creator.

platform.description: Source platform, such as instagram or youtube.

handle.description: Platform handle or stable channel reference.

markets.description: Markets the creator explicitly operates in or consistently discusses; not audience geography analytics.

audience.description: Compact audience hypothesis for downstream personalization.

summary.description: Concise description combining market, segment, and core person when supported.

needs.description: Observed or reasonably summarized audience problems, barriers, or desired changes.

positioning.description: The most coherent account positioning supported by current creator context and content.

niche.description: One English homepage sentence for downstream search, same shape as mobile creator_account.niche. Not an enum, id, or pillar. Omit when the public bio, display name, and follower count cannot support a specific audience-and-topic sentence.

content_profile.description: Reusable content themes and mechanisms for downstream content tasks.

pillars.description: Recurring content themes worth preserving or testing.

formats.description: Observed content formats such as reel, feed, short, or video.

hooks.description: Reusable opening mechanisms, not verbatim scripts.

caption_phrases.description: Recurring short phrases taken verbatim from the creator's own captions, ranked by how many distinct posts contain them, in the original content language. Deterministically extracted, never rewritten or translated: downstream retrieval matches literally against captions, so paraphrased mechanisms retrieve nothing.

languages.description: Observed content languages or explicitly requested output languages.

key_missing_info.description: Small set of missing stable facts that would materially change downstream recommendations.

extensions.description: Allowlisted incubator fields that downstream tasks must not require.

offer.description: Creator product, service, course, or consulting offer when explicitly provided or consistently stated.

content_style.description: Optional recurring style signals supported by multiple content samples.

hashtags.description: Repeated hashtags observed in source captions.
